why: I checked every command in both briefs against the repository facts. Every file they name exists at this commit: bin/greet.js, docs/index.md, test/greet.test.js, src/greet.js, README.md and .github/workflows/pages.yml. `npm test` maps to the existing "node --test" script. The shell syntax is valid: `test "$(node bin/greet.js --shout Ada)" = "HELLO, ADA!" && echo PASS || echo FAIL` is correct quoting and test usage, and `grep -n -- '--shout' docs/index.md` uses `--` so the pattern isn't read as an option. `node bin/greet.js Ada | od -c | head -2`, `cat docs/index.md` and `echo "exit=$?"` are all well-formed. The curl calls use real flags (`-sS -m 20 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n'`), and `grep -c -- '--shout'` is valid. The `--shout` invocations rely on flag support that the builder's step 1 adds. No command depends on a missing file or a malformed argument.
